name: Glacial Shield
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Slot —; Price 7,175 gp; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +2 light shield is made from compacted ice and snow, giving it a bluish-white hue. The shield weighs less than its steel and wooden counterparts. It still imposes a 5% arcane spell failure chance, but has no armor check penalty. The shield deflects incoming fire-based attacks. Each ranged fire-based attack directed at the shield’s wielder for which the attacker must make an attack roll has a 50% miss chance. The wielder must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed, helpless, or otherwise unable to act.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells resist energy; Cost 3,675 gp.
